htn_kidney.title: Trends in 10th Revision of the International Classification of Diseases-Coded CKD Incidence Among Chinese Adults.
htn_kidney.authors: Zeng Z, Cheng S, Hu Y
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究（样本量约为 723）。核心观点：慢性肾脏病（CKD）是一个日益严重的公共卫生问题，但有关其在中国发病率的证据有限。 临床提示：中国嘉道理生物样本库 (CKB) 招募了来自中国 10 个地区的 512,723 名 30 至 79 岁的参与者，我们利用该数据分析了 5 种主要 CKD 亚型：糖尿病肾病 (DKD)、高血压肾病
htn_kidney.abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a growing public health concern, yet evidence on its incidence is limited in China. Using data from the China Kadoorie Biobank (CKB), which recruited 512,723 participants aged 30 to 79 years from 10 areas across China, we analyzed 5 major CKD subtypes: diabetic kidney disease (DKD), hypertensive nephropathy (HTN), glomerulonephritis (GN), chronic tubulointerstitial nephritis (CTIN), and obstructive nephropathy (ON). Total CKD included the aforementioned subtypes, CKD due to other reasons, or chronic kidney failure. Outcomes were ascertained through linkages to local death and disease registries and health insurance databases until December 31, 2018. Poisson re...

htn_kidney.title: Identification of ATF3 as a Potential Key Biomarker for Hypertensive Nephropathy via Single-Cell Transcriptome Sequencing.
htn_kidney.authors: Tan F, Hu R, Du J
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：高血压肾病（HTN）是终末期肾病（ESRD）的主要原因。 临床提示：其发病机制很复杂，涉及多种细胞类型的异质性改变。
htn_kidney.abstract: Hypertensive Nephropathy (HTN) is a leading cause of end-stage renal disease (ESRD). Its pathogenesis is complex, involving heterogeneous alterations across multiple cell types. Currently, there is a lack of specific biomarkers capable of early detection of renal injury and reflecting molecular pathological characteristics. We performed an integrated analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data derived from renal tissue samples of HTN patients and healthy controls. Cell subpopulations were identified via dimensionality reduction and clustering, and key genes were screened using differential expression analysis. Furthermore, we employed functional enrichment analysis, non-negative ...

portal_hypertension.title: Mechanical approach of some liver diseases and their impact on hemodynamics.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝循环系统由两个流入血管网络（肝动脉（HA）和门静脉（PV））、肝毛细血管（正弦曲线）和由肝静脉形成的流出网络组成。 临床提示：我们基于考虑血管壁弹性和脉动血液的一维健康肝脏循环模型，提出了非酒精性脂肪性肝病 (NAFLD) 和充血性肝病 (CH) 的新型机械模型
portal_hypertension.abstract: The hepatic circulatory system consists of two inflow vascular networks -the hepatic artery (HA) and the portal vein (PV)-, liver capillaries (sinusoids), and an outflow network formed by the hepatic veins. We present novel mechanical models of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and congestive hepatopathy (CH), building on our 1D healthy liver circulation model that considers vessel wall elasticity and pulsatile blood flow and pressure. NAFLD is emulated by modeling sinusoids compressed by fat-laden hepatocytes (reducing their cross-sectional area), and adopting NAFLD-reported wall elasticity. This leads to a moderate increase in sinusoids inlet pressure (portal hypertension) that gro...

portal_hypertension.title: Hepatopulmonary syndrome as presentation of pediatric metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sakhuja S, Beer SS, Patel KR
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：儿童肥胖正在增加，并导致严重的合并症，其中代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病（MASLD）使个体容易患上肝硬化。 临床提示：我们描述了一名年轻的 11 岁西班牙裔男性，他因代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎 (MASH) 而出现继发于肝硬化门静脉高压的肝肺综合征，需要进行肝移植
portal_hypertension.abstract: Childhood obesity is rising and leading to serious co-morbidities, among which is metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) predisposing individuals to cirrhosis. We describe a young 11-year-old Hispanic male who presented with hepatopulmonary syndrome secondary to cirrhotic portal hypertension from metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), necessitating liver transplantation. Despite lifestyle modifications post-transplantation, the patient experienced persistent weight gain and recurrence of steatosis, emphasizing challenges of managing pediatric MASLD. The burden of childhood obesity is increasing and impacting children significantly earlier than prev...

portal_hypertension.title: Gastric antral vascular ectasia: A rare etiology of gastrointestinal bleeding in children.
portal_hypertension.authors: Alharbi O, Kasturi S, Yanni G
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：GAVE 通常与慢性疾病有关，在成人中更常见。 临床提示：胃肠道出血在儿童中相对常见。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Gastrointestinal bleeding is relatively common in children. While most patients present with mild bleeding, gastric antral vascular ectasia (GAVE) is a rare but potentially life-threatening cause. GAVE is typically associated with chronic conditions and more common in adults. The incidence, diagnosis, and management of GAVE in the pediatric population have not been established. We present two cases of GAVE with severe and chronic gastrointestinal bleeding. The first patient, a 7-year-old with chronic granulomatous disease who had melena and anemia following hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT). Endoscopic intervention with argon plasma coagulation (APC) was successful in achieving ...

portal_hypertension.title: Management of parastomal variceal bleeding with endoscopic ultrasound-guided coiling and human thrombin/fibrinogen injection.
portal_hypertension.journal: VideoGIE : an official video journal of the American Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy
portal_hypertension.authors: Tomar S, Abbasi A, Chandan S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：造口旁静脉曲张是门脉高压患者胃肠道出血的罕见但严重的原因。 临床提示：常规治疗包括手术修复或介入放射栓塞，但这些对于晚期疾病可能不可行。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Parastomal varices are an uncommon but serious cause of gastrointestinal bleeding in patients with portal hypertension. Conventional treatments include surgical revision or interventional radiology embolization, but these may not be feasible in advanced disease. Endoscopic ultrasound (EUS)-guided therapy offers a minimally invasive alternative. We describe 2 cases using EUS-guided coiling and combined thrombin/fibrinogen injection for parastomal variceal bleeding. Two patients with colorectal cancer and prior liver metastases developed recurrent bleeding from parastomal varices despite conservative or interventional radiology management. Feeding vessels were identified by EUS, accessed with ...
